histogram.name: ContextualTasks.Context.TabOverlapCount

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.ExtensionHandshake.Latency
histogram.summary: Time from when a Search Web document connects to the Contextual Tasks component extension Service Worker port until the page acknowledges readiness (HandshakeResponse). Recorded once per connection attempt, and only when the handshake succeeds, so this measures the latency of successful handshakes rather than overall health; pair it with ContextualTasks.ExtensionHandshake.Status to see the failure mix.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.ExtensionHandshake.Status
histogram.summary:
Outcome of a Contextual Tasks component extension Service Worker port handshake with the Search Web page. Normally recorded once per connection attempt; if the getHandshakeMessage() Mojo reply drops after the browser registers the connection, both 'Mojo request failed' (from the Service Worker) and 'Frame detached' (when the browser page state tears down) may be recorded for the same attempt.
'Host origin rejected' means the connecting origin was not on the allow list. 'Invalid document ID' means the connecting document could not be validated in the browser process. 'Mojo request failed' means the Service Worker's getHandshakeMessage() call failed. 'Frame detached' means the page navigated away, reconnected, or was destroyed before the handshake completed.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.ExtensionPostMessage.Error
histogram.summary: Recorded each time a search message between the Contextual Tasks component extension Service Worker port and the Search Web page is dropped. Emitted once per dropped message, so a single session may contribute many samples and this cannot be read as a per-page rate.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.ExtensionPostMessage.QueuedSearchMessagesDropped
histogram.summary: Number of browser-originated search messages that a Contextual Tasks page search state was still holding (or dropped due to queue overflow) when the page navigated, reconnected, or was torn down. Search messages that arrive before the handshake completes are queued and flushed once ready; this counts the ones that were never sent. Recorded once per page connection, including when the count is zero, so the share of sessions that lost messages can be read directly from the zero bucket. Queuing itself is expected, so this is reported separately from ContextualTasks.ExtensionPostMessage.Error.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.FileUpload.HttpStatus
histogram.summary: Recorded when an HTTP response is received for a contextual file upload request. Records the HTTP status code of the response.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.FileUpload.NetError
histogram.summary: Recorded when a contextual file upload request completes at the network layer (either successfully or with an error). Records the network error code. Not recorded if the upload failed before a network request was made, e.g. due to an authentication failure.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.Navigation.HttpResponseCode.ExcludeZeroStateLoads

A value of 1 means it succeeded (or failed persistently) on the first try. Recorded when the fetch process finally completes. Slices: {OAuthTrigger}

histogram.summary: Records the number of attempts (tries) required to successfully complete the OAuth access token fetch for Contextual Tasks. This includes transient error retries. A value of 1 means it succeeded on the first try. Recorded when the fetch process finally completes successfully. Slices: {OAuthTrigger}

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.RemovedContext.CountPerQuery
histogram.summary: Recorded upon query submission (in TakeRemovedContexts when constructing a ClientToAimRequest or search URL). Records the number of unique previously submitted tab contexts removed since the last query turn and sent to the server in the query request's removed_contexts list (including 0 when no contexts were removed).

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.RemovedContext.Reason
histogram.summary: Recorded upon query submission once for each unique removed tab context sent to the server in removed_contexts, indicating the reason the persisted tab context was removed (user deselected, browser tab closed, browser tab navigated, or Smart Tab Sharing disabled).

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.RemovedContext.RemainingTabsCount
histogram.summary: Recorded upon every query submission (in MarkQuerySubmitted, after TakeRemovedContexts prunes removed tabs and ClearFiles promotes newly submitted tabs). Records the total number of persisted tabs attached to the session for that turn.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.Session.Completed
histogram.summary: Recorded every time a cobrowsing session has completed in the contextual tasks framework. This can happen if the side panel is explicitly closed by the user, the window housing the side panel is closed, or the Chrome session has ended. Note that a cobrowsing session is only considered to have started if a user enters a query via the side panel. Always recorded as true.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.Session.Duration.AioToCobr
histogram.summary: Recorded when a cobrowsing session opened via AIO2Cobr (AI Overviews to CoBrowse) flows is closed or ended. Measures the time elapsed from when the cobrowse panel was opened until it was closed.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.Session.Duration.EphemeralToolbarButton
histogram.summary: Recorded when a contextual tasks side panel session opened via the ephemeral (unpinned) toolbar button is closed or ended. Measures the time elapsed from when the side panel was opened via the ephemeral toolbar button until it was closed.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.Session.Duration.PermanentToolbarButton
histogram.summary: Recorded when a contextual tasks side panel session resumed via the permanently pinned toolbar button (functioning ephemerally under Pinning v2) is closed or ended. Measures the time elapsed from when the side panel was reopened via the permanent toolbar button until it was closed.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.SidePanel.TimeToFirstContentfulPaint
histogram.summary: Recorded when the contextual tasks side panel renders its first contentful paint (DidFirstVisuallyNonEmptyPaint) after being opened. Measures the elapsed time from the initial side panel Show() request until the visual paint event occurs in the embedded WebContents.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.SidePanel.TimeToHandshakeComplete

Measures the elapsed time from the initial side panel Show() request until the frontend application is initialized and connected.

histogram.name: ContextualTasks.ThreadContextLibrary.CommittedTabContextCount
